description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'KeyHandlerException' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Exception'. The class extends PHP's base Exception class and provides static methods to generate specific exception instances with predefined messages related to key handling errors.

classes.name: KeyHandlerException
classes.description: Custom exception class for key handling errors within OrangeHRM's core exception namespace, providing specific static methods to instantiate exceptions with relevant messages.

methods.name: keyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating that the key already exists.

methods.name: failedToCreateKey
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating failure to create a key.

methods.name: keyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating that the key does not exist.

methods.name: keyIsNotReadable
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating that the key is not readable.
